response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_addresses, COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) AS city_count FROM address) SELECT cc.city_id, cc.address_count, cc.address_count * t.city_count / t.total_addresses AS ratio_to_avg, cc.address_count / t.total_addresses AS share FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY share DESC, cc.city_id LIMIT 10;
